entities.summary: Miles Aldridge is a British fashion photographer and artist. His monographs include Acid Candy (2008); The Cabinet (2006); Pictures for Photographs (2009); and Other Pictures (2013). Aldridge's work is held in the collection of the National Portrait Gallery, London.
